name: Chennai Port
notes: TNEB coal handling moved to Ennore (Kamarajar) after 2001; Madras High Court ordered on 11-May-2011 that coal/iron ore handling stop (shifted to Ennore from 1-Oct-2011); Supreme Court allowed resumption with conditions in Sept 2012 but the port ceased coal handling in Oct 2012. Included for history only.

name: Udangudi captive offshore coal jetty (Kallamozhi)
notes: Offshore jetty about 8 km off the Kallamozhi coast built by ITD Cementation for Udangudi Stage-I. MoC logistics plan: Chandrabila block coal railed about 200 km to Paradip, then 1,224 nautical miles by sea to this jetty.

name: ITPCL captive jetty (Parangipettai / C. Pudupettai, Cuddalore) - under construction
loc_precision: approx: unnamed OSM pier (way 1305008985) next to the ITPCL site; identification inferred
notes: Until the jetty is finished, ITPCL's imported coal is handled at Karaikal Port, about 133 km away, and railed on Indian Railways to a 5 km captive siding (IL&FS teaser, Nov 2023). ITPCL holds a coal CCOW licence at Upau, South Kalimantan, Indonesia.
status: under construction (IL&FS investment teaser, Nov 2023: about 50% complete)

name: Karaikal Port (Puducherry UT)
operator: Karaikal Port Pvt Ltd (developed by MARG group)
notes: Handles coal and pet coke and sends 4-5 coal rakes a day. Imported coal for ITPCL (Cuddalore) is unloaded here and railed about 133 km to the plant (IL&FS teaser, Nov 2023). Nearest port to Nagai TPP (Okkur, about 9 km per GEM); CEA lists Nagai as RAIL-SEA-ROAD with loading- and unloading-port stocks. The Karaikal-Nagai link is inferred, not confirmed.

name: Kattupalli Port (Adani)
notes: Coal is not among this port's approved cargoes (EC for berths 4-5, Mar 2025). Listed only because it sits next to Kamarajar.

name: Paradip Port
role: ["loading: MCL Talcher/Ib Valley coal for coastal shipping (RSR)", "import"]
notes: Main loading port for Tamil Nadu's domestic coal. FY22 MCL RSR despatch via Paradip was 24.84 Mt, including 10.92 Mt for TANGEDCO, 4.27 Mt for NTECL Vallur and 0.97 Mt for NTPL. Coal terminals: Mechanised Coal Handling Plant (MCHP), East Quay coal terminal, Kalinga International Coal Terminal (import) and Western Dock.

name: Visakhapatnam Port
notes: FY22: 2.5 Mt of TANGEDCO's MCL coal was loaded here (MoC ICLP). Coal terminals: EQ1, EQ1A, Vizag Seaport (EQ8/EQ9) and Vizag General Cargo Berth (Vedanta).
